requirements.text: Minimum of 5 years of experience working in product engineering or related fields.

Product engineering and ownership. Strong full-stack fundamentals and proficiency in frontend and backend development. Ability to work independently and engage with product and domain experts, spot gaps, and own the ideas through to production. Experience shipping real-time and text- based LLM products is nice to have. Weʼre language-agnostic; familiarity with Rails and React is a bonus.Brain Team Job Rec1

Customer-centric thinking: have a deep connection of our customers' needs and how that translates to the experiences that we build for them. Much of your work will be tuning the agent to cater towards that, so you must be comfortable working backwards from a customer's preference and finding ways to capture human judgment as success criteria for an agent.

Agent fundamentals. You understand the core building blocks of agents: traces, context and tokens, tools, system prompts, models, latency and reasoning tradeoffs, MCP, etc. You know how to troubleshoot a LLM response and identify the source of the issue in the trace. You have an opinion on the strengths and weaknesses of different frontier models. You know what agents are and are not good for. Hands-on work with an LLM observability system, building or contributing to an eval system is a plus.

Agentic development. Comfortable building alongside agents and utilizing coding agents effectively in your daily development. You can recognize poor quality code and writing produced by agents and know how to steer them towards a high-quality outcome on large tasks. You know how to use them to automate easy/repetitive tasks and build your domain expertise.

Experience building software for marketing, sales, or go-to-market teams, particularly integrations with Salesforce and other CRM platforms. You understand how customer data, lead qualification, routing, and sales workflows fit together, and can translate that understanding into reliable product experiences.
